subject: Mobile Development
title: How Mobile Ads Work
description: A 60-second lesson on How Mobile Ads Work.

hook.text: Every time you see an ad in an app, an auction happened in milliseconds to show it to you.

buildup.text: Real-time bidding lets advertisers compete for ad impressions based on user profiles.

discovery.text: Ad networks match user data with advertiser targeting: age, location, interests, and behavior.

twist.text: The entire auction — from bid to display — happens in under 100 milliseconds, every single time.

climax.text: Mobile advertising is a $400 billion market built on instant automated auctions for your attention.

punchline.text: Every ad you see won an auction in milliseconds.

quiz.question: How are mobile ads selected for display?
